course_name_original: Introduction to Machine Learning for Engineering (M2064)
course_name_en: Introduction to Machine Learning for Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: The students learn basic techniques of Machine Learning (ML).
They learn the basics of selected ML techniques such as KNN, support vector machines, Gaussian processes and kernel regression.
They are also familiar with neural networks and their training.
The students are able to decide whether given learning task from engineering are classification or regression problems.
They know essential differences between unsupervised, supervised and reinforcement learning.
They can formalize nonlinear programming problems via KKT conditions.
They can apply basic concepts from statistics and stochastics.
They can apply the following to simple problems: KNN, support vector machines, Gaussian process and kernel regression, and artificial neural networks.
The students can collaborate across boundaries of disciplines and in international teams.
The students can formulate questions and problems with respect to complex issues.
They can program selected techniques on their own in Python.

assessment_rules: A Midterm contributes 20% as a bonus. The main examination is a 90-minute written exam.
